meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲：劉淑莉
中譯英：王建玫

lines.a: 在黑暗之中 我遇見祢
lines.b: In the darkness, I found You there
Lighting up my life so fair

lines.a: 在絕望之中 祢尋見我
lines.b: In my despair, You came to me
Held me close, set me free
In my weakness and my fear
I give it all, for You are near
You lift my shame, renew my soul
With You, my life is whole

lines.a: 祢寶血為我而流 使我得自由
lines.b: Your precious blood was shed for me, bringing freedom, setting me free

lines.a: 何等偉大的愛 超乎萬有
lines.b: Oh, what a love so great, above all things

lines.a: 我獻上我全所有 為祢而活
lines.b: To You my all, my life, I bring

lines.a: 何等犧牲的愛 使我得拯救
lines.b: Such sacrifice that saves my soul, now I am whole

lines.a: 祢寶貴十架 為我付上代價
lines.b: Your precious cross, the price You paid
Is the strength by which I'm saved

lines.a: 天堂敞開 祢是榮耀君王
聖潔的羔羊 祢已勝過死亡
lines.b: Holy Lamb, You've conquered death's sting

lines.a: 我全心仰望 永恆盼望
lines.b: In You, my hope, my heart's retreat

lines.a: 何等犧牲的愛 使我得拯救
lines.b: Such sacrifice that saves my soul, now I am whole
